verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents broad first-party APIs. The Marketing API has a root resource linking to all resources and covers creating contacts, sending campaigns and account exports. The Transactional API covers SMS, dedicated IPs, inbound routes and allowlists, and webhooks are documented. However, nothing claims or demonstrates that every UI capability is exposed programmatically. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that UI features like the drag-and-drop email builder, A/B/multivariate testing, predictive segmentation, generative AI and Analytics AI are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
